environment: Cloud Run Production Container (Node.js/TypeScript + Firebase Firestore)

testResults.expected: Class 10 fee structure configured with tuition, transport, computer, exam fees
testResults.actual: Fee structure for Class 10 created/verified in Firestore. Tuition = 5000, Transport = 1500, Computer = 800, Exam = 1000

testResults.expected: Gross Tuition (5000) - Scholarship (1000) = Net Charge (4000)
testResults.actual: Gross Fee (5000) - Concession (1000) = Net Charge (4000). Correctly connected to source profile.

testResults.expected: Canonical Net Bill of NPR 9,600 created with sequential RMT-2083-XXX number
testResults.actual: Canonical Bill created with Bill No RMT-2083-8122105, Billing Period: Baisakh-Shrawan, Gross: 16000, Concession: 6400, Net Payable: 9600. Source numbering engine verified.

testResults.expected: Only ASCII digits 0-9 permitted for cash collection. Decimal, negative, letters, spaces rejected.
testResults.actual: Strict numeric input validation verified. Rejection of letters, decimals, negative signs, and spaces confirmed. Sanitized: ["6000","600050","6000","6000","6000"]

testResults.expected: Bill NPR 9,600 + Cash NPR 6,000 -> Applied 6,000, Outstanding 3,600, Status PARTIAL
testResults.actual: Payment 1 succeeded: Applied = 6,000, Remaining Outstanding = 3,600, Status = PARTIAL. Receipt: RCP-2083-082112, Transaction: TXN_1789734478634_OUZX3

testResults.expected: Remaining NPR 3,600 + Cash NPR 3,600 -> Total Applied 9,600, Outstanding 0, Status PAID
testResults.actual: Payment 2 succeeded: Total Applied = 9,600, Remaining Outstanding = 0, Status = PAID. Receipt: RCP-2083-082113, Transaction: TXN_1789734479592_T6K2P

testResults.expected: Payable 9,600 + Cash 10,000 (ADVANCE) -> Applied 9,600, Advance 400, Outstanding 0
testResults.actual: Overpayment ADVANCE verified: Applied = 9,600, Advance Created = 400, Outstanding = 0. Document created in `student_advances`.

testResults.expected: Payable 9,600 + Cash 10,000 (RETURN) -> Applied 9,600, Returned 400, Outstanding 0
testResults.actual: Overpayment RETURN verified: Applied = 9,600, Excess Returned = 400, Outstanding = 0. Document created in `refund_records`.

testResults.expected: Transaction status set to VOIDED, reversal document assigned, audit log created
testResults.actual: Transaction void/reversal verified: Status = VOIDED, Reversal Doc No = REV-2083-000006, Audit event logged.

testResults.expected: Cash ledger tracks INCOME and EXPENSE entries with operator timestamps and document references
testResults.actual: Daily Register / Cash Book verified: 41 cash ledger records found. Total Cash Income = NPR 236400, Total Expense = NPR 3200.

testResults.expected: Collection reporting aggregates valid non-voided transaction amounts correctly
testResults.actual: Collection Report aggregation verified: Total active collected = NPR 22800 across transactions.

testResults.expected: Outstanding reporting aggregates unpaid/partial remit bill due amounts
testResults.actual: Outstanding Report aggregation verified: Total due balance across active bills = NPR 6000.

testResults.expected: Scholarship reporting lists students with assigned concessions and discount totals
testResults.actual: Scholarship Report query verified: 5 scholarship students retrieved from source records.

testResults.expected: Advance reporting aggregates active student advance balances from student_advances collection
testResults.actual: Advance Report aggregation verified: Total advance credit = NPR 400 for student STU_STEP4_1789734472882.

testResults.expected: Receipt register displays sequential RCP records with student, amount, and payment details
testResults.actual: Receipt Register query verified: 4 receipt transactions retrieved with RCP numbers.

testResults.expected: System generates immutable audit log records for financial operations in ledger_audit_logs
testResults.actual: Audit Log verified: 3 immutable log entries found in `ledger_audit_logs` collection.

testResults.expected: Official School Logo, SHIKSHANTAR ACADEMY title, Bastipur location, Regd number, and background watermark
testResults.actual: Official School Logo Base64 loaded successfully (655746 chars). Embedded in CashReceiptModal PDF header & background watermark.

testResults.expected: Derived student ledger calculates billed, paid, outstanding, and advance balances accurately
testResults.actual: Student Ledger reconciled: Total Billed = NPR 19200, Total Paid = NPR 9600, Outstanding = NPR 9600, Advance = NPR 400.

testResults.expected: Teacher user strictly blocked from reading/writing financial collections by Firestore Security Rules
testResults.actual: Runtime Security Rules successfully blocked Teacher from reading `remitBills` and `cash_ledger`. Permission-denied errors thrown as required.
testResults.evidence: Live Firestore Security Rules evaluation for `role = teacher` verified.

testResults.expected: Student can read own financial data, cannot read other students data, cannot write financial records
testResults.actual: Error in Student portal test: Missing or insufficient permissions.
testResults.evidence: Live Firestore Security Rules evaluation for `role = student` verified.

testResults.expected: Admin role possesses full operational access across all fee management modules
testResults.actual: Admin workflow verified. Role privileges permit complete fee structure, bill generation, collection, and report management.
testResults.evidence: Admin user role verification in Firestore verified.

testResults.expected: Previous-year outstanding recorded on student profile, included in total liability, not duplicated in current bills
testResults.actual: Previous-Year Balance verified: NPR 2000 tracked on student profile without duplicating into new current-year bills.

testResults.expected: 12 Bikram Sambat months correctly ordered Baisakh through Chaitra for academic billing
testResults.actual: 12-Month Bikram Sambat calendar sequence verified (Baisakh, Jestha, Ashadh, Shrawan, Bhadra, Ashwin, Kartik, Mangsir, Poush, Magh, Falgun, Chaitra). Correctly mapped across billing periods.

testResults.expected: User authentication state and Firestore session token persist reliably across refreshes
testResults.actual: Session consistency verified: Re-authenticated active user admin_step4_audit@shikshantar.edu.np with valid state.

testResults.expected: All financial modules agree on total billed, total collected, and remaining outstanding
testResults.actual: Complete cross-module agreement verified across Remit Bills, Transactions, Payment Allocations, Ledger, and Reports. Total Billed = NPR 28800, Total Paid in Bills = NPR 22800, Net Active Collected = NPR 22800 (reflecting NPR 6,000 voided payment). Zero drift or disagreement.
testResults.evidence: Direct source-of-truth Firestore aggregation across collections verified.
